questions.q: What is the difference between creating a receipt and applying a receipt?
options: They are the same action with different names
Applying happens before creating
Creating records that money arrived; applying decides which open invoice(s) it pays off
Creating only applies to wire transfers
questions.explain: Creation records the cash arriving; application matches that cash to specific open invoices, reducing their balances.

questions.q: What does lockbox processing primarily automate?
options: Importing bank remittance data and creating/applying receipts at scale
Setting up new customer accounts
Running credit checks on new orders
Generating sales order pricing
questions.explain: Lockbox imports remittance data from the bank and uses it to create and automatically apply receipts for matching invoices.

questions.q: What happens when a lockbox receipt's remittance data doesn't clearly match an open invoice?
options: The payment is rejected and returned to the customer
Nothing happens at all — the cash disappears
The customer's account is automatically closed
The receipt is still created, but Receivables generates recommended matches for manual review
questions.explain: The cash is still recorded as a receipt, but when automatic matching isn't confident, a person reviews recommended matches.

questions.q: Why did Harborview's payment on SO-48217 apply automatically with no manual review needed?
options: Because all payments are always automatic
Because the remittance referenced the exact invoice number and the exact amount owed
Because Harborview is a new customer
Because the payment was late
questions.explain: An exact match on invoice number and amount let lockbox processing apply the receipt automatically.

questions.q: Is an unapplied ("on account") receipt a sign that something is broken?
options: Yes, it always indicates a system error
Yes, it means the customer did not actually pay
No — it's a routine, expected part of a collections team's daily work when a match isn't automatically clear
No, but only for brand-new customers
questions.explain: Unapplied receipts needing manual review are a normal, expected occurrence, not evidence of a system problem.
